title: Delete a specific command from history
summary: Remove a single command from your history list by its line number. This is useful if you accidentally typed a sensitive command or want to remove a specific mistake.

aliases.text: kak udalit odnu komandu iz istorii

steps.explain: Delete the history entry at the specified line number (offset).

placeholders.name: OFFSET
placeholders.description: The line number of the command to delete, as shown in the history list.

steps.expect: The specified command is removed from the history list.
